[LSIG.4.1] DS guarantees strict replay determinism in all modes, `realtime`
included ([LDET]). A series backing's output enters the operator log, so each
backing must use only correctly-rounded operations, in a fixed fact order:
IEEE-754's add, subtract, multiply, divide, `sqrt` and `fma`, and the
correctly rounded transcendentals the author-facing surface admits
([LDET.3.4.4]). That is the bar the author-facing surface is held to, so
there is no guard band anywhere to reason about ([LDET.3.4.1]).
